{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid ion blast Mark II''' was an upgraded version of [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech's]] [[Droid ion blast Mark I|Mark I]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] weapon. This model was equipped with a beam splitter that enabled the ion beam to be directed at multiple target droids simultaneously.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
